items.name: Niger
facts: Principal river of West Africa.
The “Boomerang” river, rising in the Guinea Highlands.

items.name: Senegal River
items.fact: Forms most of the Senegal–Mauritania border.
facts: Forms most of the Senegal–Mauritania border.

items.name: Volta
facts: Principal river of Ghana.

items.name: Gambia River
items.fact: The river that gives The Gambia its shape.
facts: The river that gives The Gambia its shape.
Navigable far inland.

items.name: Benue
facts: The Niger’s longest tributary.
Joins the Niger at Lokoja, Nigeria.

items.name: Lake Volta
items.fact: Among the world’s largest reservoirs by area.
facts: Among the world’s largest reservoirs by area.
On the Volta in Ghana, behind Akosombo Dam.

items.name: Lake Chad
items.fact: Shallow African lake; size varies greatly.
facts: Shallow African lake; size varies greatly.
Shared by Chad, Cameroon, Niger, and Nigeria.

items.name: Kainji Lake
facts: Nigeria’s largest lake.
A Niger River reservoir behind Kainji Dam.

items.name: Lake Bosumtwi
facts: Ghana’s only natural lake.
In a meteorite crater near Kumasi.

items.name: Lake Kossou
facts: Largest lake in Côte d’Ivoire.
A Bandama River reservoir.

items.name: Atlantic Ocean
facts: Ocean west of West Africa.
